response.justification: MOC-2007-0112 was raised at Cape Verity Export Terminal on 27 August 2007 as a scheduled change under engineering change note; no event precedes it in the record. The engineering change note record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to strengthen the key safeguard named in the documents in scope. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the key safeguard set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are ALERT-2016-007, MOC-2014-0087, PRO-MEC-041, PRO-OPS-017 and PTW-STD-003.
